home.hero_label: Est. in the Heart of Odessa
home.hero_description: Where Italian precision meets the architectural soul of Ukraine. We craft more than furniture; we forge the heritage of your home.
home.philosophy_quote: We do not believe in the temporary. Every piece that leaves our workshop is built to witness a century of family gatherings.
home.philosophy_body: Rooted in the rich artisan traditions of Odessa and inspired by Italian furniture design, our atelier specialises in hand-crafted joinery that defies mass-market standards. We source only sustainable hardwoods, treated with natural oils to preserve the living soul of the material.
home.cta_body: Contact our head atelier for a private consultation. We specialise in full-home interior solutions and unique standalone statements.

about.title: The Master
about.subtitle: Igor Vasylkov — Bespoke Furniture Atelier, Est. 2002
about.body:
In the years following Ukrainian independence, Igor Vasylkov — a former military officer — navigated an unstable economy like so many of his generation, often working two jobs at once. He arrived at a conviction: he needed work that was truly his own. A life's work.

It began at home — designing and building the kitchen of his new apartment with his own hands. What started as necessity became a calling. In 2002, Igor founded his private atelier in Odessa, built on a single guiding principle: take only the work that demands excellence, and execute it without compromise.

For over two decades, that principle has attracted private homeowners, restaurateurs, and commercial developers across Ukraine and beyond — clients who understand that the right furniture is not purchased. It is created.
about.craft_text:
Where others seek simplicity, we seek the commission nobody else will take. Complex, multi-element projects — full apartment interiors, restaurants, commercial spaces — are not a challenge here, they are our standard.

We work end-to-end: directly with clients to shape their vision, and alongside architects and interior designers, applying rigorous technical analysis to every proposed solution. The question we always ask: will this serve you well for decades?

We work with any wood species, any material — oak, walnut, metal, glass, seamless integration with existing structures — with equal precision. What consistently surprises our clients is what they did not expect to be possible: the individuality and warmth of bespoke craftsmanship, delivered with the consistency and precision of industrial production.

Furniture built not just for today — but to be inherited.
